gui.realmcasino.slots_rules: Three independent reels. Every symbol has a 1 in 8 chance on each reel. All 512 combinations are equally likely.
gui.realmcasino.slots_rtp: Theoretical return: 95.3125% · House edge: 4.6875%. This is a long-run average, never a promise for one session.
gui.realmcasino.roulette_rules: 37 equally likely pockets: 0–36. One straight number returns 36×; red, black, even and odd return 2×. Zero loses all outside bets.
gui.realmcasino.roulette_rtp: Theoretical return: 36 / 37 ≈ 97.2973%. House edge ≈ 2.7027%. Number: 1 / 37. Outside bet: 18 / 37.
gui.realmcasino.blackjack_rules: A fresh, shuffled 52-card deck for every hand. Aces count as 1 or 11. Dealer stands on every 17, including soft 17. No split, double, insurance or surrender.
gui.realmcasino.blackjack_returns: Win: 2× · Natural blackjack: 2.5× · Push: 1× · Loss: 0×. All returns include your stake. Stakes must use even cents.
gui.realmcasino.blackjack_rtp: Your choices affect the return. No fixed RTP is claimed. Leaving a hand follows the published server recovery rules.
gui.realmcasino.payout_explanation: A 2× return on a €10 stake pays €20 in total: €10 stake + €10 profit.
gui.realmcasino.hidden_card: One card stays hidden until settlement.

gui.realmcasino.blackjack_leaving: A hand has 60 seconds. Closing the menu, leaving range or disconnecting stands automatically. The result is kept for collection, including when you are offline.
